activation_policy: A canonical spell may consume resources only through an explicit evidence-bearing timing policy. Unresolved timing fails closed.

atomicity.start: Capture resource state before reserve/commit; restore on sink failure.
atomicity.finish: Capture resource state before commit/refund; restore and permit retry on sink failure.
atomicity.idempotency: Duplicate start and duplicate terminal processing are rejected.

assumptions: The available promoted record establishes spell identity and effect magnitude, but does not establish resource type, cost, or consumption timing.
canonical_policies.safe_fallback: Reject cast resource processing until resource type, cost, and timing are independently promoted.
canonical_policies.runtime_impact: Prevents accidental free casts or invented resource consumption for spell.1304.
canonical_policies.character_save_impact: No resource mutation or persistence is permitted while timing is unresolved.

runtime_ownership.lifecycle: Combat/Spells owns ordering, reservation identity, terminal transition, rollback, and traceable policy selection.
runtime_ownership.resource_sink: Character/NPC ownership supplies balances and performs persistent resource mutation.
runtime_ownership.persistence: Only the owning resource sink may persist committed changes; reservations are temporary unless later evidence proves persistence.
